description:
List the user's stock portfolio holdings.

Returns each position (shares, average cost, current price, market
value, profit/loss, weight) from brokerage-linked and manually
entered trades, plus totals. Use this when the user asks what they
own or how their positions are doing. Don't use it for a public
ticker the user doesn't own (use stock_analysis).

Limits: requires sign-in. Prices are cached snapshots that can be up
to 7 days old; positions without a price are labeled, never guessed.
Users with no holdings yet see a demo portfolio, clearly labeled.
name: list_portfolio

Position.description: One holding in the user's portfolio, from a linked brokerage or entered by hand.

price_source.description: Where the price came from: broker_derived = brokerage value / shares; cached_snapshot = saved market price, up to 7 days old; cache_miss = no price (value uses cost); demo_snapshot = fixed price of the labeled sample portfolio.
price_source.title: Price Source

Position.title: Position

outputSchema.description: The user's holdings with totals. is_empty means there are no holdings to show.

sign_in_hint.description: A sign-in or setup tip. Never a paid offer.
sign_in_hint.title: Sign In Hint

outputSchema.title: PortfolioResult

title: List My Portfolio Holdings
